$comment: Hand labels for eval/results/after2-precision-requirement.json. 105 of its 230 rows
are the same sentences the BEFORE pass already judged, carried by (rfc, text) through
eval/apply-labels.mjs: a label is a judgement about a sentence, so the same sentence
keeps it. The other 125 were judged fresh against eval/PRECISION-RUBRIC.md.
Duplicate rows in this sample: 4, against 7 in the BEFORE sample of 200. That accounts
for three points of the change; the rest is that the rows the prose fix made reachable
are overwhelmingly real prose obligations, while the pre-existing list was loaded with
the keyword glossary of RFC 2119/8174 and with flattened table rows.
notes: after2-REQ002 and after2-REQ003 are the same sentence in RFC 1122 and RFC 1123 ('An implementation is not compliant if it fails to satisfy one or more of the MUST requirements...'). Two documents, two rows, and both are real: the corpus-wide duplicate count is per document, deliberately.

after2-REQ119 ends at 'MAY send' and after2-REQ202 is a parenthetical cross-reference. Both are rows the splitter produced from a block that continues; the requirement is in the block, the row is not a statement.
The eight carried false rows are the same false positives as in BEFORE: the RFC 2119 and RFC 8174 keyword glossaries, list introducers, and front-matter blobs.
